name: ZOTTMAN CURL
introduce:
Stand with your feet shoulder width apart. Hold a dumbbell in each hand. 

Extend your arms and place them at your sides with palms facing each other. 

Rotate your palms to make them face forward. Bend your arms and raise the dumbbells to your shoulders. 

Rotate your palms again to make them face downward, then lower them down. Repeat the exercise.

tips.text: Please prepare two dumbbells that you feel comfortable with.
Squeeze your biceps at the top.
Exhale as you raise the dumbbells, and inhale as you lower them.
This exercise works your biceps and forearms.
